title: Classify and migrate provably local-only legacy named-root history
outcome: Provide safe legacy-origin remediation without fabricating canonical naming authority or reviving old evaluation tokens.
acceptance: Recoverable local-only provenance retires behind an acknowledged invalidation tombstone and requires fresh evaluation preparation; unexplained positive history stays explicitly unresolved with repair guidance.
Regression tests distinguish local-only no-event migration from unexplained positive history, preserve unknown-submission bytes, and reject pre-migration tokens across restart.
